Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the privacy/data handling items we discussed so procurement/security will have a clear record: 

1) Opt-out for "training on customer data": Acme Fin requested that any data routed to Redwood for inference NOT be used to improve / fine-tune Redwood models or training corpora. You asked for a written confirmation we can sign.
2) PII handling: We confirmed Redwood will apply PII minimization recommendations and can support masking of specific fields at the request of your security team.
3) Logging & retention: Default inference logs are retained for 90 days; we can propose a custom retention policy or export-only mode for audit windows.
4) Data residency: You are evaluating US-only residency and asked about options for dedicated/private deployments.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll generate a formal "Training-on-Customer-Data Opt-Out" confirmation document for signature (we can DocuSign).
- I’ll loop in our security lead (Rishi) to provide detail on logging controls, retention windows, and where redacted logs can be exported.
- If helpful, we can produce a short write-up (1 page) of the PII handling practices we follow.

I’ve attached our Data Handling Statement for your review and the security questionnaire you sent earlier (filled with high-level answers). Please confirm if the opt-out language below matches Agme Fin’s intent, and whether we should proceed to a signed confirmation: 

"Acme Financial requests that any customer-provided data processed by Redwood Inference for live inference will not be used to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve Redwood models. Redwood will segregate or exclude Acme Financial data from any model training processes and will provide a signed confirmation to that effect."

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up if you want to walk through any of the details.

Hi all —

Thanks for the ping, Marissa. Below are the answers we can provide to Acme’s security team and the language we propose for the signed confirmation. I’ve attached the draft confirmation doc (training-opt-out-confirmation.docx) for review.

Proposed confirmation language (short):
"Redwood Inference confirms that Acme Financial customer-provided data processed via Redwood’s hosted inference services will not be used to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve Redwood models. Redwood will segregate Acme Financial data from model training datasets and will exclude it from downstream model improvement pipelines. This confirmation applies until rescinded in writing by Acme Financial or superseded by a separate commercial agreement."

Technical answers: 
- Logging & retention: Default inference telemetry (request/response bodies and metadata) is retained for 90 days in our hosted offering. We can provide an export of logs at any time. For customers requiring stricter retention, we offer a 30-day default or a no-storage option under Dedicated/Private (export-only / ephemeral mode) — this can be contractual.
- Granularity: By default we capture request/response tokens, timestamps, latency metrics, and a hashed request id. Full request/response bodies are retained by default for 90 days but can be configured to redact or not store bodies.
- PII masking: We support configurable field-level masking at ingestion (customer-managed rules or our recommended patterns). When masking is enabled at ingestion, PII fields are not stored in logs or telemetry.
- Data residency: Dedicated deployments can be pinned to a US region; Private (on-prem / VPC-hosted) supports full US-only residency. On-prem installations typically require a 6–10 week engagement (depending on size and procurement). We can provide an SOW estimate once we know target infra.

Attachments included: 
- training-opt-out-confirmation.docx (draft)
- redwood-data-handling-statement.pdf (copy)

Next steps:
- Marissa / Neha: please review the draft confirmation and let me know if edits needed.
- Olivia: if the language looks ok, we’ll send the final doc via DocuSign and include the retention options in the contract appendix.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
